is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluates the performance of LLINs against wild pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports the molecular detection of the L1014F kdr mutation (Page 3, Determination of the pyrethroid resistance status of An. gambiae s.l).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Kdr frequencies are reported for each site in Table 1 (Page 5), and the sample size is specified as 30 mosquitoes per locality (Page 3).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Malanville (Benin), Pitoa (Cameroon), and Vallée du Kou (Burkina Faso) (Page 2, Study areas).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study describing experimental hut trials and molecular genotyping (Page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: Data are tied to specific sites: Malanville (11°87N; 03°38E), Pitoa (9°21N; 13°31E), and VK7 in Vallée du Kou (11°24N; 4°24E) (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted between September and November 2007 in Vallée du Kou, and between July and September 2008 in Malanville and Pitoa (Page 5).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study mentions the experimental stations belong to the Anopheles Biology & Control (ABC) network, but the data presented appear to be specific to this PermaNet 3.0 evaluation (Page 2).

supplement.evidence: Genotype frequencies and sample sizes are provided in the main text and Table 1. Supplementary files mentioned on page 10 contain additional bioassay results (exophily, blood feeding, mortality) but are not required for the genotype data.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the field efficacy of PermaNet 3.0 mosaic LLINs against pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations in Benin, Cameroon, and Burkina Faso using experimental huts. It reports Vgsc L995F (L1014F) kdr frequencies for field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.s. (M and S molecular forms) from Malanville (16%), Pitoa (<5%), and Vallée du Kou (>80%), based on a sub-sample of 30 mosquitoes genotyped per locality.
